svg.title: Zaitun Hills: 28 ha masterplan
svg.desc: Site plan of Zaitun Hills seen from above, the stream at the bottom and the foothills at the top. 60 numbered villa plots in four rows and 6 apartment blocks, two boulevards, the central garden with its reflecting pool, the gym and courts, the playground, the mosque by the main gate, parking, planting and levels.

g.text: 28 ha masterplan · phase one: 60 villas and 24 apartments · Northern foothills, Erbil
Drawn from components/sawad/scene/layout.ts · metres · scale 1:2200 at 96 dpi
4.2° above the horizon, light falls this way
Stream to hillside. Heights are drawn at twice their scale; the homes beyond the line are shown faintly.
24 × 22 m around a court, 780 m² plot
20 × 16 m with a lower wing, 560 m² plot
17 × 14 m with a lower wing, 420 m² plot
32 m wide, floors step to the stream
the bank, the terraces, between the plots
Landscape 58% once phase two is built
70% until then: the reserve is planted as olive terraces.
120 carport spaces (two per villa) and 112 in shared courts
North is not confirmed. The sun shown is the scene's golden-hour sun.
The mosque is drawn facing the boulevard; it turns to face Mecca once north is known.
Tree positions are indicative. The planting zones are what the plan fixes.
